name: Wayne Gretzky
one_line: His assists alone outnumber every other player's total career points.

facts.claim: career totals: 2,857 points - 894 goals and 1,963 assists
facts.note: In hockey a point = a goal or an assist. This definition must be explained in-script per the sport-explainer rule.

facts.claim: he has more assists than any other player has total career points
facts.note: Wikipedia verbatim. THE fact - equivalent to: delete all 894 of his goals and he is still the highest scorer in history. Chart: gold = his assists 1,963 vs gray = Jagr's entire career 1,921.

facts.claim: second on the all-time scoring list is Jaromir Jagr, with 1,921 career points
facts.note: NHL.com official. Jagr needed 24 seasons to get there.

facts.claim: at retirement in 1999 he held 61 NHL records: 40 regular season, 15 playoff, 6 All-Star
the only player ever to score 200 points in a season - he did it four times
facts.note: Wikipedia: 'the only NHL player to total over 200 points in one season, a feat he accomplished four times.' Everyone else in history: zero times.

facts.claim: scored 92 goals in the 1981-82 season - still the single-season record
four Stanley Cups with Edmonton (1984, 1985, 1987, 1988); his number 99 is retired across the entire league
facts.note: No player on any NHL team may ever wear 99 again.

comparison.gap_description: 1,963 assists against 1,921 total points for second place - his passes outscore everyone's everything.

story_beat: If you deleted every goal Wayne Gretzky ever scored - all 894 of them - he would still be the highest-scoring player in NHL history, on assists alone.
